title: Number of Segments in a String
description:
Given a string s, return the number of segments in the string.
A segment is defined to be a contiguous sequence of non-space characters.

examples.example_text:
Input: s = "Hello, my name is John"
Output: 5
Explanation: The five segments are ["Hello,", "my", "name", "is", "John"]

constraints: s consists of lowercase and uppercase English letters, digits, or one of the following characters "!@#$%^&*()_+-=',.:".
The only space character in s is ' '.

test_snippets.python3:
def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(s = "Hello) == 5
    assert candidate(s = "Hello") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "Punctuation) == 1
    assert candidate(s = "New\nlines\nare\nalso\nsegments") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "Mixed    \t  \n  delimiters    should    work") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "NoSpaces") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "OneTwoThreeFour") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "\t   \t   Hello   \t   my   \t   name   \t   is   \t   John   \t") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "") == 0
    assert candidate(s = "Multiple    spaces between words") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "   Hello) == 5
    assert candidate(s = "Leading and trailing spaces should be ignored   ") == 7
    assert candidate(s = "Punctuation) == 5
    assert candidate(s = "123 456 789 0") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "Mixing\t\nand\tspecial\t\ncharacters") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "Multiple   spaces   between words") == 4
    assert candidate(s = " Leading and trailing spaces ") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "\tTabs\tare\tconsidered\tspaces") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "\t\t\tTabbed\t\t\tSegments\t\t\t") == 2
    assert candidate(s = "  a  b  c  d  e  ") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "\u0020\u0020\u0020Unicode\u0020spaces\u0020\u0020\u0020") == 2
    assert candidate(s = "    a   b   c   ") == 3
    assert candidate(s = "   ") == 0
    assert candidate(s = "Hello\tmy\tname\tis\tJohn") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "    ") == 0
    assert candidate(s = "\nNew\nlines\nare\nspaces\ntoo") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "Punctuation) == 6
    assert candidate(s = "Multiple     spaces   between   words") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "   Hello) == 5
    assert candidate(s = "a b c d e f g") == 7
    assert candidate(s = "Hello    my     name    is    John") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "\tTabs\tare\tcounted\tas\tspaces") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "Mixed\tTabs\t\tand\t\t\tSpaces") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "   Leading and trailing spaces   ") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "Multiple    spaces    between   words") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "SingleWord") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "Tab	Separated") == 2
    assert candidate(s = "\nHello\nmy\nname\nis\nJohn\n") == 5
